name: NW-contact-v01

request.prompt: TARGETED SINGLE KEYFRAME EDIT. From the supplied existing three-pose NW attack sheet, replace ONLY its nominated CONTACT pose with a completed FORWARD strike. Output EXACTLY ONE isolated complete character figure, no other poses or grid. Preserve exact dedicated demon identity and BACK-LEFT/NORTHWEST camera: thick RED muscular biped, ONEhead, TWO overlapping black swept horns, TWO arms/TWO clawed legs, heavy SPIKED gunmetal shoulder/forearm/shin armor, rear belt/iron chains/loincloth, thick attached tail, NOwings/shield/white recolor/lava. NOfront chest/skull buckle facing viewer. Head/nose/toes aim UPPER LEFT. ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand is the FAR arm, starting at SCREEN RIGHT shoulder, and grips the ONE huge crescent iron axe with longwoodshaft. ANATOMICAL LEFT arm is NEAR, starting at SCREEN LEFT shoulder, with OPEN EMPTY claw kept LOW at left hip. Do NOT put the weapon in that near left claw. Show the RIGHT shoulder on far side clearly connected to the arm sweeping forward across the FAR SIDE of upper back/neck; elbow STRAIGHTENS FORWARD, wrist/fist reaches beyond the nose toward UPPER LEFT at shoulder height, gripping shaft. Axe blade reaches a FULL HEAD LENGTH ahead of and UPPER LEFT of nose, diagonally out toward enemy, at a line aligned with facing NW. The axe is NOT held overhead: blade is forward beyond head, its lower cutting edge at enemy torso/contact height. Do NOT show a raised ready-to-chop pose; show end-of-strike arm extension and actual blade reach. Left EMPTY near claw remains separately visible LOW near hip so hand ownership is unmistakable. Torso/hips drive forward into contact, front foot planted NW, rear legbraced, heavy body settles into blow. Keep axe shaft continuous/right grip touching. Full horns/axe/tail/feet complete in CENTRAL SIXTY PERCENT of landscape transparent canvas with huge outer margins. Oneconnectedcharacter silhouette, no detachedobjects/shadows/floor/effects/sparks/glow/text/grid. TRUE alpha0background.
